caption: The drawing features a single, prominently displayed vase set against a plain, light beige background. The vase is rendered in shades of blue, including deep and lighter blue tones, with swirling patterns giving it a marbled appearance. There are also yellowish circular and flower-like spots distributed across the surface of the vase. The mouth of the vase is wide and oval in shape, and the vase itself tapers slightly at the neck before curving outward and then narrowing again towards the base. The overall composition centers the vase with ample empty space around it, and there is a signature visible at the lower right pinkish-beige edge of the drawing.
title: Pinch Vase
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
